spec.rawSql:
SELECT 
  p.crop AS metric,
  SUM(f.harvest_kg) / NULLIF(SUM(p.surface_m2), 0) AS value
FROM agri_dw.fact_harvest f
JOIN agri_dw.dim_parcel p ON f.parcel_dim_id = p.parcel_dim_id
JOIN agri_dw.dim_zone z ON p.zone_id = z.zone_id
WHERE z.zone_name LIKE '$zone'
GROUP BY p.crop
ORDER BY value DESC;

SELECT 
    SUM(f.sold_kg * f.unit_price_fcfa) AS "Chiffre d'affaires"
FROM agri_dw.fact_harvest f
JOIN agri_dw.dim_parcel p ON f.parcel_dim_id = p.parcel_dim_id
JOIN agri_dw.dim_zone z ON p.zone_id = z.zone_id
WHERE z.zone_name LIKE '$zone';

SELECT 
    harvest_date AS "time",
    parcel_id AS "Metric",
    taux_perte AS "Value"
FROM agri_dw.kpi_post_harvest_loss
ORDER BY harvest_date;

WITH h AS (  
    SELECT parcel_dim_id, SUM(harvest_kg) AS kg  
    FROM agri_dw.fact_harvest 
    WHERE $__timeFilter(date_id) 
    GROUP BY parcel_dim_id
), 
i AS (  
    SELECT parcel_dim_id, SUM(water_volume_m3) AS m3  
    FROM agri_dw.fact_irrigation 
    WHERE $__timeFilter(date_id) 
    GROUP BY parcel_dim_id
)
SELECT 
    p.crop AS "Culture", 
    SUM(h.kg) / NULLIF(SUM(i.m3), 0) AS "Efficience"
FROM h
JOIN i ON i.parcel_dim_id = h.parcel_dim_id
JOIN agri_dw.dim_parcel p ON p.parcel_dim_id = h.parcel_dim_id
JOIN agri_dw.dim_zone z ON z.zone_id = p.zone_id
WHERE ('$zone' = 'All' OR z.zone_name = '$zone')
GROUP BY p.crop
ORDER BY 2 DESC;

SELECT 
    AVG(k.taux_perte) AS "Taux Global de Pertes"
FROM agri_dw.kpi_post_harvest_loss k
JOIN agri_dw.dim_parcel p ON k.parcel_dim_id = p.parcel_dim_id
JOIN agri_dw.dim_zone z ON p.zone_id = z.zone_id
WHERE z.zone_name LIKE '$zone'
  AND p.crop LIKE '$crop'
  AND $__timeFilter(k.harvest_date);

SELECT 
    AVG(f.harvest_kg / NULLIF(p.surface_m2, 0)) AS "Productivity"
FROM agri_dw.fact_harvest f
JOIN agri_dw.dim_parcel p ON f.parcel_dim_id = p.parcel_dim_id
JOIN agri_dw.dim_zone z ON p.zone_id = z.zone_id
WHERE z.zone_name LIKE '$zone'
  AND p.crop LIKE '$crop'
  AND $__timeFilter(f.date_id);

WITH h AS (
    SELECT parcel_dim_id, SUM(harvest_kg) AS kg  
    FROM agri_dw.fact_harvest  
    WHERE $__timeFilter(date_id)  
    GROUP BY parcel_dim_id
), 
i AS (
    SELECT parcel_dim_id, SUM(water_volume_m3) AS m3  
    FROM agri_dw.fact_irrigation  
    WHERE $__timeFilter(date_id)  
    GROUP BY parcel_dim_id
)
SELECT SUM(h.kg) / NULLIF(SUM(i.m3), 0) AS "Efficience d'Irrigation"
FROM h
JOIN i ON i.parcel_dim_id = h.parcel_dim_id
JOIN agri_dw.dim_parcel p ON p.parcel_dim_id = h.parcel_dim_id
JOIN agri_dw.dim_zone z ON z.zone_id = p.zone_id
WHERE ('$zone' = 'All' OR z.zone_name = '$zone')  
  AND ('$crop' = 'All' OR p.crop = '$crop');

SELECT 
    w.date_id AS "time",
    w.temperature_c AS "Température (°C)",
    SUM(i.water_volume_m3) AS "Volume d'irrigation (m3)"
FROM agri_dw.fact_weather w
LEFT JOIN agri_dw.fact_irrigation i ON w.date_id = i.date_id
LEFT JOIN agri_dw.dim_parcel p ON w.zone_id = p.zone_id
WHERE ('$zone' = 'All' OR w.zone_id IN (SELECT zone_id FROM agri_dw.dim_zone WHERE zone_name = '$zone'))
  AND ('$crop' = 'All' OR p.crop = '$crop')
GROUP BY w.date_id, w.temperature_c
ORDER BY w.date_id ASC;

SELECT 
    p.parcel_id AS "ID Parcelle",
    p.crop AS "Culture",
    z.zone_name AS "Zone",
    p.surface_m2 AS "Surface (m²)",
    p.planting_date AS "Date de plantation"
FROM agri_dw.dim_parcel p
LEFT JOIN agri_dw.dim_zone z ON p.zone_id = z.zone_id
WHERE ('$zone' = 'All' OR z.zone_name = '$zone')
  AND ('$crop' = 'All' OR p.crop = '$crop')
ORDER BY p.parcel_id ASC;

SELECT 
    p.parcel_id,
    p.latitude,
    p.longitude,
    p.surface_m2,
    p.crop AS culture
FROM agri_dw.dim_parcel p
JOIN agri_dw.dim_zone z ON p.zone_id = z.zone_id
WHERE ('$zone' = 'All' OR z.zone_name = '$zone');
